The Edron orcs guard their equipment well in the underground hideout. Go down floor by floor through the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave}, face many {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and open the box at the end of the last room to receive a {item:Barbarian Axe} and a {item:Scimitar}.
The orcs of Edron keep their equipment well guarded in their underground hideout.
No minimum level, but level 40+ is recommended.
advisable (not mandatory) for the last floor
Always kill the {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} first: they hit the hardest.
Bring enough potions: the last floors have large groups of Berserkers.
1. Get to the Edron Orc Cave

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Enter through the Edron Flats cellar

Enter the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave} through a hole in the cellar of the **Edron Flats**. The {wiki:Edron Flats|Edron Flats} are the apartments just **south** of Edron castle: look for the {item:Sewer Grate} in the cellar, go in and follow the sewer until you come out on the surface on the other side.
The Sewer Grate in the Edron Flats basement
Never go without a {item:Shovel}: the entry spot always has to be dug out and, without a shovel, you can't get back to Edron without help from other players.
Cross the surface to the south

Go **south**, fighting {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. Go down the hole that leads to a cave near the coast further **south**. The cave entrance is hidden under a mountain: if you can't see it, use the minimap.
The entrance of the Edron Orc Cave, hidden under the mountain
If, when you enter the first floor, the way is blocked by a stone, use the lever next to it to remove it.
The {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave} is on an orc peninsula **southwest** of Edron castle, reached through a sewer in the cellar of the **Edron Flats**.

On this floor you find {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. Follow the arrow to the hole and go down.
First floor: follow the arrow to the hole

Here you find {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} and probably one or two pulled {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. Find the next hole and go down.
Second floor: path to the next hole

As soon as you go down, you face {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. To save potions, stand in the **bottom-left** corner (southwest): that way only 3 monsters can hit you at the same time. Kill the Berserkers first and then go down the hole.
Right after you go down the hole you will meet 3 to 5 {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. Follow the arrow carefully: there are more Berserkers along the way.
**Advance carefully!** Using a {item:Stealth Ring} here is highly advisable.
Last floor: follow the arrow to the final room, in the south

When you enter the final room, to the **south**, you have to face 3 or more {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, 2 {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders} and 2 to 3 {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}.
Open the box at the far **south** of the room to receive the reward.

Go back the same way: on each floor return to the spot where you fell and use the {item:Rope} to go up (following the same maps in reverse). On the first floor go back **north** to the entrance and leave to the surface.

On the surface, go **north** to where you came out of the sewer and retrace the path to the **Edron Flats** cellar (dig the passage with the {item:Shovel} if it is covered). At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities.
